body: Concrete minimal invocation-basis shape for your ruling: require LocalCostModel to expose its CostWeights; GraphHsmm derives HsmmResult.costWeights from the actual model instance; HsmmResult.validated binds every Assessed.eligibleWeights exactly to that basis restricted to the row's eligible terms; hsmm/v4 encodes the complete basis; HsmmResultCodec.decode/decodeJson require expected CostWeights and reject a wire mismatch. This kills the c538 caller-selected-weight attack while keeping the claim to support accounting, not general model identity. The fallible producer API independently rejects non-finite prior/floor/total. If you intend total-cost provenance too, this is insufficient and needs a broader cost-model receipt; I will not infer that widening.
